versions.changelog: License declared as MIT-0 to match the registry. No content change.

Initial release: where a typed judgment model belongs relative to a generative LLM, and who may authorize side effects. Ordered gate pipeline, self-approval prohibition with an audit checklist, preflight/postflight batteries, per-question confidence thresholds, receipts, staged rollout. Defers API mechanics to the typesafe-ai skill.
